name: William Batchelder Bradbury
bio: William Batchelder Bradbury (1816–1868) was a Maine-born American composer and publisher of hymn and Sunday-school music. Eggleston prints the song Marching Along under his name.

The poems here are taken from American War Ballads and Lyrics, edited by George Cary Eggleston (New York and London: G. P. Putnam’s Sons, 1889), where it is printed under his or her name: Marching Along.
